source: Illustrative stop records prepared for Para development. Coordinates are approximate landmarks from OpenStreetMap-based geocoding (Photon/Komoot). Stop names and route associations derive from a public Cebu Daily News Digital route-code guide.

stops.name: JY Square (Lahug)
stops.source: Photon/Komoot (OpenStreetMap contributors), accessed during Phase 2; landmark name also appears in a public Cebu Daily News Digital guide.
stops.notes: Secondary sources support the stop name and its use in the simplified 04L route description. The coordinate is an approximate landmark. Stop sequence, direction, fare, schedule, and geometry are not verified.
stops.sourceOrganization: Suroy.ph; Cebu Daily News Digital; Photon/Komoot (OpenStreetMap contributors)
stops.evidenceReference: Suroy.ph Cebu City Jeepney Guide 2026 lists 04L as "JY Square to Ayala and SM" and advises boarding around JY Square and confirming Ayala or SM. Cebu Daily News Digital May 15, 2026 cites "04-L | Lahug (JY Square) – SM: via Ayala Center Cebu". Coordinates are approximate OpenStreetMap-based landmarks.
